question: Should read-scoped `openclaw health` include live-vs-disk runtime config drift for model/provider/auth/secrets paths and recompute it on cache hits before this PR merges?
rationale: The code appears correct, but this is an auth-adjacent health surface and latency policy choice that green CI cannot settle for maintainers.

options.title: Accept the diagnostic boundary
options.body: Merge after maintainer review confirms that drift paths without sensitive values are appropriate for operator.read and the cache-hit disk read is acceptable.

options.title: Restrict or reshape the surface
options.body: Ask the author to make the drift summary admin-only, probe-only, or otherwise narrower if read-scoped visibility or health latency is not acceptable.

options.title: Close in favor of behavior-only work
options.body: Close this PR and rely on the companion restart-policy PR if maintainers do not want a separate health diagnostic surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the diagnostic boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review confirms that drift paths without sensitive values are appropriate for operator.read and the cache-hit disk read is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the adjacent health-cache/status work and are the best available routing owner for the final health-surface tradeoff.
